name: iphone-use
description: Let Codex operate a real iPhone over USB, with guided setup, app automation, a live screen and screenshot fallback.

interface.longDescription: Read and operate a real iPhone through PUA (Phone Use Agent). It diagnoses USB, Xcode and signing configuration, reuses healthy connections for taps, scrolls, text input and multi-step tasks, shows the phone screen live, falls back to screenshots and coordinates when element targeting fails, and verifies key results.
defaultPrompt: Help me install iPhone Use, set up my iPhone and verify the connection.
Use iPhone Use to complete my phone task and verify the final key result.
